messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to publish Python + TS SDKs in the Tues change window (2025-02-12 02:00-04:00 UTC). Staggered cohorts: canary -> cohort A -> cohort B -> GA. Will pin legacy sync wheels for 1 week.
jon: thanks — what's the canary cutoff?
maria: canary tag publish at 02:05 UTC. If no red flags in 2h we'll promote cohorts at ~04:10 and 05:30 for GA.
alex: adding: run `npm publish --tag canary` for ts and `twine upload --repository pypi canary/*` for py. echoing prerelease checksum step.
maria: exact commands pinned in shiproom doc, but yes. I'll start preflight checks at 01:30 UTC and do a final sign-off at 01:55.
deploy-bot: scheduled job queued: sdk-publish-1749999999 canary -> cohort (initiated by maria). ETA 02:00 UTC. Reaction :rocket:
rachel: I can monitor telemetry dashboards and error budget traces during canary. If median latency regresses >15% or error rate >0.5% we halt and roll back.
sre-bot: alert policy armed for sdk-publish-1749999999. On-call paging: primary eng-oncall.
maria: for rollback criteria: signature mismatch, packaging checksum fail, or runtime API break (major error class). For smaller regressions we may pin canary and hold cohort.
jonalex: minor note — legacy sync client will be soft-deprecated in release notes. We'll add migration snippet and point to compat shim: `from redwood import LegacyClient -> from redwood import AsyncClient`
elaine: docs team will push deprecation banner and update changelog entry. ETA 06:00 UTC same day.
jon: what about npm org rate limits? we should stagger cohort A and B by region to avoid bursts.
maria: yes — cohort A: NA/EU, cohort B: APAC. We'll place 20m gap between cohort promotions.
rachel: I'll set up a quick smoke prompt set and eval run after each cohort promotion. If eval fails, manual hold.
deploy-bot: canary completed at 02:07 UTC (no blocking failures). Job id: jb-1749999999-canary.
sre-bot: observed 2 transient 500s in canary window, spike at 02:10 -> auto-retry succeeded, no SLO breach.
maria: ok moving cohort A at 04:12 UTC. Alex please stand by for signer check.
onalex: will verify signatures and checksums immediately, and unpin if any mismatch. Commands: ```gpg --verify dist/*asc && sha256sum -c checksums.txt```
maria: if we detect signer mismatch we revert by unpublishing canary and re-tagging; if GA issue we bump patch and republish under GA with rollback note.
rachel: remind that we also need to update the console releases tab and Slack release announcement template after GA.
maria: yes — I'll draft announcement in #marketing after GA.
jon: any plan for consumer pin guidance? Recommend `pip install redwood-sdk==<GA>` for deterministic installs; we'll publish a migration note to allow `redwood-sdk` to point to shim for 30d.
maria: agreed. Also keeping a revert playbook in the shiproom doc: quick steps, who to page, and commands.
deploy-bot: cohort A promotion completed at 04:13 UTC. cohort B scheduled for 04:33 UTC.
sre-bot: no new alerts during cohort A, perf looks stable.
elaine: changelog PR merged at 05:05 UTC, includes deprecation message and migration snippet.
maria: GA cut at 05:32 UTC. publishing GA tags now.
deploy-bot: GA publish succeeded at 05:35 UTC. Release artifacts: npm@1.2.0, pypi@1.2.0.
jon: will start the soft-deprec announcement to partner channels.
rachel: evals post-GA show quality parity with canary. closing monitoring window in 24h but will keep eyes for 72h on crash-free.
maria: thanks all. If you spot anything after the fact, drop it here and we'll follow the rollback playbook. :thumbsup:
